reasons.plausibility: It is consistent with well-established understanding that chromium- and molybdenum-containing oxide films form passivation layers in corrosion-resistant steels.
reasons.testability: The proposal includes a well-defined, straightforward experimental design with clear measurements to verify or refute the presence and effect of the passive film.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a direct, methodical approach to disentangling the role of Cr–Mo passivation layers in severe service conditions, providing valuable insight for improving corrosion resistance of steels.
